relationships.subject: GDF-15
relationships.evidence_quote: Incubation of GDF-15 (1.2 nmol/L) for 20 min significantly reduced the current density of Nav1.8 channels in DRG neurons either from naïve or arthritic rats

relationships.subject: GDF-15
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicated that GDF-15 decreased the excitability of small-diameter DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: ALK2
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment of DRG neurons with 10 μmol/L DMH-1 significantly blocked the GDF-15-induced suppression of Nav 1.8 currents

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: Although the PKA inhibitor H89 (1 μmol/L) and the MEK/ERK inhibitor PD98059 (10 μmol/L) did not affect Nav1.8 currents per se, either of them significantly blocked the GDF-15-induced suppression of Nav1.8 currents

key_findings: Peripheral GDF-15 is analgesic in naive and CFA-arthritic rats and suppresses Nav1.8 currents
GDF-15 acts via ALK2, PKA and MEK/ERK (not PKC), with ALK2 co-localizing with Nav1.8 in DRG neurons
